name: data-convert
about: Your data — CSV, TSV, a JSON array of objects or JSON Lines — converted to another of those formats with every record and field kept: the same field names, the same values (3.50 may become 3.5 and an empty cell null or a left-out field, but 02134 stays 02134), in the same order unless you say any. Proves nothing was lost, added or changed; renaming or reshaping fields is a different task.
instructions: Reply with the converted data only (one fenced block is fine). Keep every record, every field under its exact name, and every value as written; codes with leading zeros stay text. CSV: a header row and RFC 4180 quoting. TSV: a header row, tab-separated. JSON: one array of flat objects. JSON Lines: one object per line.

source_format.about: the source's format: csv, tsv, json or jsonl

format.about: the format wanted: csv, tsv, json or jsonl

order.about: keep (the records in the source's order) or any
